typography.strategy: Technical, bold sans-serif headings for high-impact authority. Clear, modern sans-serif for body to ensure legibility on mobile.

spacing_and_layout.strategy: Generous spacing. Mobile-first layout emphasizing vertical scroll and quick access to CTAs.

buttons.primary: bg-yellow-500 text-black font-bold py-4 px-8 rounded-none hover:bg-yellow-400 transition-colors shadow-[0_0_15px_rgba(234,179,8,0.3)]
buttons.secondary: bg-transparent border-2 border-blue-500 text-blue-500 font-bold py-4 px-8 rounded-none hover:bg-blue-500 hover:text-white transition-all
buttons.whatsapp_floating: fixed bottom-6 right-6 z-50 bg-[#25D366] text-white p-4 rounded-full shadow-[0_4px_14px_rgba(37,211,102,0.4)] hover:scale-110 transition-transform flex items-center justify-center

cards.service_card: bg-[#14141A] border border-zinc-800 p-8 rounded-lg hover:border-yellow-500/50 transition-colors group
cards.testimonial_card: bg-[#14141A] border border-zinc-800 p-6 rounded-lg flex flex-col gap-4

icons.style: Stroke width 2, high contrast colors (Yellow or Blue depending on the service)

motion.hover: Subtle transform translate-y-[-2px] and border color shifts
motion.entrance: Fade in up for sections using framer-motion (viewport once: true)

sections_to_build.name: Header
sections_to_build.details: Sticky glassmorphism header. Left: Logo/Text 'J&H'. Right: Phone number & small WhatsApp button. Must be z-50.

sections_to_build.name: Hero
sections_to_build.details: Background image of concrete texture or electrician working, with heavy bg-black/60 overlay. Huge H1 'Electricista y Plomero de Confianza en Villahermosa'. Urgency subheadline. Large Yellow CTA 'Solicitar Servicio por WhatsApp'. Social proof badges (+48 Reseñas).

sections_to_build.name: Services
sections_to_build.details: 3 columns. Electricidad (Yellow accents), Plomería (Blue accents), Especiales (Mixed). Use icons. List specific services.

sections_to_build.name: Why Choose Us
sections_to_build.details: Bento grid or 4-column layout. Emphasize: 5 years experience, 5-star reviews, Fast response, Guarantee.

sections_to_build.name: Testimonials
sections_to_build.details: Grid of 4 testimonials. Include 5 yellow stars, short text, and a professional portrait/name.

sections_to_build.name: Location & Hours
sections_to_build.details: Embedded Google Maps of Villahermosa. Business hours listed alongside.

sections_to_build.name: Footer
sections_to_build.details: Dark, large final CTA. Links to Facebook, Instagram, WhatsApp. Contact info clearly visible.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure yellow text/buttons on dark backgrounds have at least 4.5:1 ratio. Button text should be black for high contrast against yellow.
accessibility.data_testid_rule: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute in kebab-case.

instructions_to_main_agent: Implement a high-converting, mobile-first landing page. Do not use generic Shadcn cards; use raw HTML/Tailwind for custom layouts. Ensure the sticky WhatsApp button is always visible. The hero image needs a dark overlay (bg-black/60) so text is highly legible. The design should convey urgency and trust, not a start-up vibe. Use lucide-react for icons. Install framer-motion if using scroll animations.
